scope_notes: This is an observed API and builtin-plugin inventory, not a candidate compatibility receipt.
The fixture mounts each reported builtin auth and secret plugin, both KV versions, and the database engine. Default system, identity, cubbyhole and token mounts remain present.
Custom external plugins and deployment-specific routes may extend this inventory. Their behavior, CLI, Agent, Proxy, UI, provider effects and migration still need separate qualification.
The legacy OpenBao 2.6.2 corpus is unchanged and is not relabeled as 2.7.0.
The original HTTP bodies here were decoded by the shared TLS client. This manifest does not claim literal raw HTTP byte parity.
